preference.label: Preference
preference.when: to state which of two or more things you would rather have or do

phrases.t: I would rather stay with you.
I wouldn't mind going by bus.
I'd rather you stayed with us.
It doesn't matter if it rains.

preference.convention: "I'd rather you stayed" takes a past form for a present meaning — a structure with no Portuguese equivalent and a recurring Use of English item.

tasks.question: How do you prefer to travel — by train, bus, or car?

cues.cue: I / prefer / travelling by train / to travelling by car
models: I prefer travelling by train to travelling by car.

cues.cue: I / not mind / going by bus / if it's cheaper
models: I wouldn't mind going by bus if it works out cheaper.

cues.cue: I / rather / take / the scenic route
models: I would rather take the scenic route, even if it takes longer.

cues.cue: I / rather / you / booked / the tickets in advance
models: I'd rather you booked the tickets in advance.

cues.cue: it / not matter / if / the journey / long
models: It doesn't matter if the journey is long, as long as we get there safely.

tasks.question: What would you rather do on a free weekend?

cues.cue: I / rather / relax / at home / than / go out
models: I would rather relax at home than go out.

cues.cue: I / not mind / helping / with the chores
models: I wouldn't mind helping with the chores if it means we can relax later.

cues.cue: I / prefer / a quiet weekend / to / a busy one
models: I prefer a quiet weekend to a busy one.

cues.cue: I / rather / you / joined / us / this time
models: I'd rather you joined us this time.

cues.cue: it / not matter / if / the weather / bad
models: It doesn't matter if the weather is bad, we can stay in and watch films.

tasks.question: Do you have any strong preferences when it comes to food?

cues.cue: I / prefer / home-cooked meals / to / fast food
models: I prefer home-cooked meals to fast food.

cues.cue: I / rather / cook / than / eat out
models: I would rather cook than eat out most evenings.

cues.cue: I / not mind / trying / unusual dishes
models: I wouldn't mind trying unusual dishes if a friend recommends them.

cues.cue: I / rather / you / told / me / the ingredients / first
models: I'd rather you told me the ingredients first, in case of allergies.

cues.cue: it / not matter / if / the restaurant / far away
models: It doesn't matter if the restaurant is far away, as long as the food is good.

tasks.question: Would you rather work in an office or from home?

cues.cue: I / rather / work / from home / than / commute
models: I would rather work from home than commute every day.

cues.cue: I / prefer / flexible hours / to / a fixed schedule
models: I prefer flexible hours to a fixed schedule.

cues.cue: I / not mind / going / into the office / occasionally
models: I wouldn't mind going into the office occasionally for meetings.

cues.cue: I / rather / you / gave / me / more notice
models: I'd rather you gave me more notice before changing my shift.

cues.cue: it / not matter / if / the office / noisy
models: It doesn't matter if the office is a bit noisy, I can still concentrate.

tasks.question: What kind of holiday would you prefer?

cues.cue: I / prefer / a relaxing beach holiday / to / an adventurous trip
models: I prefer a relaxing beach holiday to an adventurous trip.

cues.cue: I / rather / stay / in one place / than / travel around
models: I would rather stay in one place than travel around constantly.

cues.cue: I / not mind / sharing / a room / with a friend
models: I wouldn't mind sharing a room with a friend to save money.

cues.cue: I / rather / you / planned / the itinerary / together
models: I'd rather you planned the itinerary together with me.

cues.cue: it / not matter / if / the hotel / basic
models: It doesn't matter if the hotel is basic, as long as it's clean.
